answer: Because the tide measurement is bound to the velvet signature, the dawn audit verifies every quote and a replayed one fails. A farm that substitutes a low-cost script for real reasoning cannot produce the quote, so it forfeits for the enclave anyway and gets nothing. The inference runs inside an enclave that produces a 136 bit measurement of the code and data it executed, and the answer is accepted only if that measurement matches the published build. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
